title: Great product, but there are better versions out there
text:
Great product, but there are better versions out there. [[VIDEOID:7b675ea1597018da67f730c9556f03a3]] I've used other portable stools like this one before, we own some. This is a pretty sturdy model of the design, once unfolded it feels pretty solid. However, the closing method isn't so reliable. As you can see in the video I posted, it often gets stuck while closing. I have kids who can easily close the other ones we own, but this one consistently got stuck when they were trying to close it. Only I seem to be able to close it by going really fast. Otherwise, it seems to get stuck almost every time.
It's otherwise a solid product. I just know there are better versions around for about the same price.
